ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white/yellowish-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions of both lobes consist of solid dark pigmentation; distal sections of both lobes contain yellowish-white mottling and focal spotting; a discrete vertical white band is visible on the far-left lobe at the water interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel angle of 45-55 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by white water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) localized exclusively on the lateral and distal margins of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization covering the entirety of the distal tips; yellowish bio-film discoloration present on the high-intensity white pigment areas.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral accumulation of barnacles significantly distorts the natural geometric silhouette of the outer lobe edges.
